question: A scheme like ‘Buy 6, Get 2 Free’ on the same kind of articles with the same MRP attracts a _____ % discount.890
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Buy 6, get 2 free ⇒ total items = 8, pay for 6

Free items = 2

Discount = (2 ÷ 8) × 100

= 25%

**∴ Answer = 25%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Buy 6 items, get 2 items free

**Formula used:**

Discount% = (Free items ÷ Total items) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total items received = 6 + 2 = 8

⇒ Items paid for = 6

⇒ Free items = 2

⇒ Discount% = (2 ÷ 8) × 100

⇒ = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

B1G Free Concept

Discount = Free items ÷ Total items

Effective Price

Customer pays for fewer items but gets more

Quick Trick

Discount = Free ÷ (Buy + Free)

Application

Useful in retail and marketing offers
